additional_info.subject: RE: AW: [External] ID0401551-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / R4 170001801] Charging station not working CRM:01410001409
additional_info.body:
Dear Lainam Thai,
I have gone through the logs, and I can see that there were 2 charging sessions which happened at 06:11 and 06:13 on the charger on 22nd January. In both the cases, the charging was stopped because the charger received an “StopTranscation” message from OCPP. Both of this happend within a couple of seconds of the start of charging session. Attached are the 2 screenshots with the timestamp.
Could you please check from the OCPP end whether the stop command was truly sent. If so, then this answers your query.
Thank you for your attention to this matter.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shreyas Sathe
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
